paragraph: The Granville timing system issues a neutral 50/100 composite verdict for this morning's session, strictly capped at a maximum potential of 60 due to an active divergence warning where the cap-weighted S&P 500 rises while equal-weight breadth decays (RSP/SPY down -0.41%). Under the hood, severe leadership erosion in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY down -2.84%) and risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV down -0.83%) offsets bullish tailwinds from a compressing VIX (-3.70%) and a risk-on rotation out of defensives (XLP/XLY down -0.83%). This internal friction is backstopped by a supportive macro volatility complex featuring a calm VIX of 15.89 in steep contango, stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.72%, and a weakening U.S. dollar ($28.25) that is driving small-cap outperformance (0.3930) despite a rising 10-year real yield of 2.36%. Given the capping effect of the breadth divergence and severe semiconductor weakness, we lean toward a choppy, neutral-to-cautious stance for the session ahead.
